status: Research reference implementation; route-specific dependencies below

methods.name: PN-FP
methods.detector_semantics: Frozen 1024-key exact response match; preserve response length and chat-template flags.
methods.cross_lineage: Canonical frozen string signatures; Qwen must not regenerate or truncate secrets.
methods.readiness: Implementation provided; frozen assets and scientific environment required

methods.name: EverTracer
methods.detector_semantics: Member-oriented AUC and TPR at empirical FPR <= .05; retain 100 member and 100 nonmember neighborhoods.
methods.cross_lineage: Canonical cross-tokenizer detector is N/A; separate exploratory AUC is not a canonical ownership result.
methods.readiness: Benchmark adapter provided; frozen assets, documented upstream components and scientific environment required

methods.name: CTCC
methods.detector_semantics: Operational strip()==IAMALIVE; 95 trigger, 100 suppression and 105 normal queries. Not an official released detector.
methods.cross_lineage: Frozen response rule is operationally applicable across lineages.
methods.readiness: Benchmark adapter provided; frozen assets, documented upstream components and scientific environment required

methods.name: iSeal
methods.detector_semantics: Registered 200 and held-out 100 secrets; sentence BLEU >=50; selected Teacher uses A6 configuration.
methods.cross_lineage: Level-3 canonical ownership claim is N/A; retain applicability limits.
methods.readiness: Implementation provided; frozen assets and scientific environment required

methods.name: SCW
methods.detector_semantics: Native statistical detector on frozen French queries and generations; retain p-value and decision rule.
methods.cross_lineage: Preserve tokenizer/alignment applicability audit and clean Qwen control.
methods.readiness: Implementation provided; frozen assets and scientific environment required

methods.name: LLMPrint
methods.detector_semantics: Frozen 200-fingerprint probability sequence; paper bit rule and release supplementary rule remain distinct.
methods.cross_lineage: Use the explicitly audited cross-lineage representation; do not infer applicability from same-lineage code.
methods.readiness: Benchmark adapter provided; frozen assets, documented upstream components and scientific environment required

methods.name: REEF
methods.detector_semantics: Centered linear CKA of frozen last-token decoder-block representations; retain reference/probe hashes.
methods.cross_lineage: Same-lineage evaluator asserts layer/shape identity; cross-lineage needs the audited distinct adapter.
methods.readiness: Implementation provided; frozen assets and scientific environment required

methods.name: HuRef
methods.detector_semantics: Frozen HuRef feature extraction and ICS comparison; original feature/calibration assets required.
methods.cross_lineage: Preserve architecture applicability and the original feature mapping.
methods.readiness: Benchmark adapter provided; frozen assets, documented upstream components and scientific environment required

methods.name: AWM
methods.detector_semantics: Native weight-space extraction, dimension/layer alignment, LAP and unbiased CKA; frozen calibration.
methods.cross_lineage: Use the canonical alignment implementation; do not substitute a generic cosine similarity.
methods.readiness: Benchmark adapter provided; frozen assets, documented upstream components and scientific environment required

methods.name: ZeroPrint
methods.detector_semantics: Frozen perturbations, queries and reference fingerprint; preserve correlation rescaling and strict threshold.
methods.cross_lineage: Use the audited query/representation protocol with clean Qwen controls.
methods.readiness: Implementation provided; frozen assets and scientific environment required
